status: proposed ontology; labels used so far are machine-distilled weak labels, not designer review

headline.description: Primary message; usually the largest or most prominent copy.

subhead.description: Supporting copy directly subordinate to the headline (tagline, subtitle).

cta.description: Call to action label or its button backplate.

badge.description: Short offer/price/date marker, often on its own small backplate.

legal.description: Fine print, contact details, URLs, disclaimers.

hero.description: The dominant subject image (product, person, scene).

decoration.description: Ornamental graphic, frame, backplate, rule or texture placed deliberately. Distinct from unknown.

unknown.description: Insufficient evidence (missing asset, empty text, unlabeled). Never treated as decoration.

relations.contains: a holds b inside its opaque area (panel, card, button backplate)
relations.aligns_with: a and b share an edge or centre line
relations.supports_on_photo: text b sits on photograph a and should stay on its quiet region
relations.overlaps: a and b intersect without containment
